name: Lina Romero
source: Lina Romero is one of the last remaining human drivers for the eponymous gig cab service. In the near-future city of Los Ojos, California, self-driving cars operated by the mega-corp Capra, Lina's former cab employer, have all but taken over. Lina goes there to move in with her longtime friend Savy and start a new life.
